content.value: A current of density 500 A/m² flows through an n-type germanium crystal. This crystal has resistivity 0.05 Ω-m and the electron mobility of 0.4 m²/Vs. Calculate the drift velocity and time taken by the electrons to travel 100 m in the crystal.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
